guardrails: preserve recognizable subjects, identities, poses, spatial relationships and source-sampled colors
derive visual marks from the shared evidence matrix
do not invent people, places, products, measurements, events, cultural claims or exact text
leave exact typography for deterministic composition

selection_contract.thumbnail_stage: use the same source image and evidence matrix for every entry
selection_contract.high_resolution_stage: render only presets recorded in an explicit selection manifest
selection_contract.reference_assets: never package external showcase images, private prompts, brand assets or copied code
selection_contract.video_references: adapt only their static visual result or shot logic unless the user explicitly requests a separate video workflow
